title: Build live multi-actor Millwood Scene 102 proof harness in prototypes/emotions/
goal: Prove (or expose failures in) the emotion, body, and speech-tone architecture under real unscripted multi-actor pressure matching Millwood Scene 102.

sections.what: Build and run an unscripted 6-character live multi-actor stress-test harness (prototypes/emotions/scene102_proof.py) for Millwood Scene 102 combining VirtualWorld's existing isolated memory/sound/tone pipeline with Track 1 (ProtoDUnifiedEngine) and Track 2 (Actor LLM) to prove whether the system reaches Scene 102's psychological fidelity.
sections.why: All prototype evaluations so far (prototypes/emotions/scenarios.py, run_compare.py) tested single characters against scripted events plus one single-turn dialogue call. A hands-off multi-actor closed loop is required to prove empirically whether emotional inertia, per-target feelings, personal tells, flustered volume slips, and distance-filtered tone actually produce realistic teenage/family drama without scripted steering.
sections.how:
1. Create prototypes/emotions/scene102_proof.py using VirtualWorld's real WorldGraph (Driveway by Gerald connected via open outdoor way to Dessert Tables), SpeechBroadcaster (engine/speech.py), engine/sound.py, distance-aware engine/speech_tone.py, isolated per-character Player.memories + engine/memory_retrieval.py, ProtoDUnifiedEngine (Track 1), and local LM Studio Track 2 Actor (google/gemma-4-e4b with '{' JSON prefill).
2. Seed Zoe, Sammy, Kayla, Kyrie, Astrid, and Maria strictly from their real millwood index profiles and Nov 26 timeline knowledge barriers (Kayla and Kyrie hold Tuesday/Wednesday memories; Sammy and Zoe do not; Astrid holds zero secrets plus Birch Lane/pharmacy/dolphin memories; Maria holds only the sisterhood cover).
3. Inject only Zoe's opening cue ("But we can't, can we?"), then run 6-8 unscripted live turns where each speaker's actual propagated volume (including any flustered volume slip), distance-filtered perceived_tone per listener, and same-area observer tells feed the next speaker's turn.
4. Write the complete untruncated transcript and per-turn Track 1 telemetry to prototypes/emotions/scene102_proof_report.json and report explicit pass/fail checks against Scene 102's psychological invariants.
sections.verify: Run python prototypes/emotions/scene102_proof.py --model google/gemma-4-e4b against local LM Studio and inspect prototypes/emotions/scene102_proof_report.json for epistemic isolation, multi-target emotion persistence, distance-filtered tone split, and unedited Track 2 dialogue quality.

acceptance.text: A reproducible multi-actor harness (prototypes/emotions/scene102_proof.py) runs 6 canon-seeded Millwood Scene 102 characters (Zoe, Sammy, Kayla, Kyrie, Astrid by Gerald; Maria 20 ft away at Dessert Tables) on VirtualWorld's real WorldGraph, SpeechBroadcaster, engine/sound.py, distance-aware engine/speech_tone.py, isolated Player.memories + engine/memory_retrieval.py, ProtoDUnifiedEngine (Track 1), and local LM Studio Track 2 Actor.

Starting strictly from Zoe's opening line ("But we can't, can we?") with hands off the steering wheel for 6-8 turns, Actor A's involuntary tells, flustered volume slip, and distance-filtered perceived tone directly feed Actor B's prompt without scripted emotional outcomes.

The full untruncated transcript and per-turn Track 1 trace (per-target emotions, autonomic channels, observer tells, volume slips, perceived tones, latencies) are saved to prototypes/emotions/scene102_proof_report.json with zero silent text truncation.

Automated assertions verify strict epistemic isolation (no leaked Tuesday/Wednesday or trust/notebook secrets into Astrid/Maria/Sammy/Zoe), Astrid's emotional inertia resisting 1-turn softening, and Maria vs close-range tone split on cover lines.

custom.browser_ui: Optional Lab view: add a Scene 102 Proof Replay tab or loader in prototypes/emotions/lab_app.py (or view prototypes/emotions/scene102_proof_report.json) showing the unedited multi-actor transcript alongside each character's per-turn Track 1 state, per-target emotions, and observer tells. Manual check: open the saved report and verify every character line is untruncated and every listener saw only what crossed the yard to them.

evidence: Live 6-turn Millwood Scene 102 proof run completed on google/gemma-4-e4b + text-embedding-qwen3-embedding-0.6b and saved untruncated to prototypes/emotions/scene102_proof_report.json.

Verified live unscripted split perception (Astrid teasing -> teasing on Sammy/Kyrie, mocking on Kayla/Zoe; Astrid sarcastic -> sarcastic on Sammy/Kayla, plain on Zoe/Kyrie), personal persona tells (eyebrow scar, sweater sleeves, lip biting, taped hand), zero secret leaks, and real sound isolation.
